_vibe_session_metadata.summary: Model quality: 94/100 (2 warnings, 0 errors). 87 tables across 9 domains.

domains.name: beneficiary
domains.description: Single source of truth for all individuals, households, and communities served by humanitarian and development programs. Owns beneficiary identity, registration, vulnerability profiling, needs assessments, consent management, and case management. Covers IDPs, PoCs (Persons of Concern), GBV survivors, and all target populations tracked in CommCare and KoboToolbox.

products.name: registrant
products.description: Core master entity for every individual registered as a beneficiary or person of concern (PoC). Stores biographic data (name, date of birth, sex, nationality), unique beneficiary ID, registration source system (CommCare, KoboToolbox), protection flags, deduplication status, and full registration metadata including registration date, location, modality (in-person, mobile, remote), registration tool, registering staff, verification documents presented, completeness score, and deduplication check results. Supports re-registration tracking with historical registration events. Serves as the single identity anchor for all beneficiary-domain transactions. Interoperable with UNHCR proGres v4 individual records, WFP SCOPE beneficiary records, and RAIS case records via standard beneficiary ID mapping.
products.reference: UNHCR Individual Registration / CommCare Case Master

attributes.name: registrant_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each registrant record in the beneficiary domain. Serves as the primary key and identity anchor for all beneficiary-domain transactions across CommCare, KoboToolbox, and interoperability mappings to UNHCR proGres v4, WFP SCOPE, and RAIS.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance — Beneficiary Identity Management

attributes.name: country_office_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to field.country_office. Business justification: Country offices manage registrant deduplication, verification, and protection status. Registrant-level reporting to donors and government partners is organized by country_office. A domain expert expec

attributes.name: dedup_master_registrant_id
attributes.description: The beneficiary_id of the authoritative master record when this registrant has been identified as a duplicate. Null for unique records. Enables lineage tracing from duplicate to canonical record for audit and reporting.
attributes.references: USAID BHA Beneficiary Deduplication Policy; UNHCR proGres v4 Deduplication Module

attributes.name: emergency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to field.emergency. Business justification: Registrants are frequently registered in the context of a specific emergency response (e.g., flood, conflict displacement). Emergency-specific registration drives require tracking which emergency trig

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking this registrant to their household unit. Enables household-level aggregation for NFI distribution, WASH targeting, and food security assessments. Household head registrant carries the authoritative household record.
attributes.references: UNHCR proGres v4 Household Linkage; WFP SCOPE Household Model; Sphere Association Household Standards

attributes.name: intervention_id
attributes.description: Externally-known unique beneficiary identifier assigned at registration, used for cross-system interoperability with UNHCR proGres v4, WFP SCOPE, and RAIS case records. Printed on beneficiary cards and referenced in all program transactions.
attributes.references: UNHCR proGres v4 Individual Record Standard; IATI Beneficiary Identification Guidelines

attributes.name: project_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to field.project_site. Business justification: Beneficiary registration occurs at specific field sites (health posts, distribution points, registration centers). Essential for geographic program planning, site-level performance reporting, and link

attributes.name: target_population_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to program.target_population. Business justification: NGO targeting workflow: registrant eligibility is validated against program.target_population inclusion/exclusion criteria (vulnerability_category, poc_category, displacement_status). Program officers

attributes.name: age_years
attributes.description: Registrant's age in whole years at the time of registration. Stored explicitly to support age-band analytics and program eligibility checks when date_of_birth is estimated or unavailable. Derived from date_of_birth where known; otherwise entered directly.
attributes.references: SPHERE Humanitarian Standards; UNHCR Age and Gender Disaggregation Policy

attributes.name: completeness_score
attributes.description: Percentage score (0–100) reflecting the completeness of the registrant's registration profile based on mandatory and recommended fields populated. Used for data quality monitoring, field staff performance tracking, and MEL data quality assessments.
attributes.references: IATI Data Quality Standards; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; UNHCR Registration Quality Assurance Framework

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: Date on which informed consent was obtained from the registrant or their legal guardian. Required for GDPR compliance audit trails and CHS accountability reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; UNHCR Data Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: consent_given
attributes.description: Indicates whether the registrant (or legal guardian for minors) has provided informed consent for data collection, storage, and use per organizational data protection policy and applicable regulations. Mandatory for all registrations per CHS Commitment 4.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; GDPR Article 6; UNHCR Data Protection Guidelines; HAP Standard

attributes.name: country_of_origin_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code for the registrant's country of origin. Distinct from nationality for stateless persons and IDPs. Used for displacement tracking, protection analysis, and OCHA SitRep reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; UNHCR Refugee Status Determination Guidelines; OCHA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this registrant record was first created in the data platform (Silver Layer). Serves as the audit trail anchor for data lineage, GDPR data retention calculations, and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Storage Limitation); FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Audit Requirements

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: The registrant's date of birth in yyyy-MM-dd format. Used for age calculation, vulnerability profiling, child protection flags, and eligibility determination for age-targeted programs (e.g., SAM/GAM nutrition screening, PSS services).
attributes.references: UNHCR proGres v4; Sphere Association Humanitarian Standards; UNICEF Child Protection Guidelines

attributes.name: deduplication_status
attributes.description: Current status of the deduplication check for this registrant record. 'Duplicate' records are suppressed from active program counts. 'Merged' indicates the record was consolidated with a master record. Supports USAID and DFID double-counting prevention requirements.
attributes.references: USAID BHA Beneficiary Deduplication Policy; WFP SCOPE Deduplication Standards; UNHCR proGres v4 Deduplication Module

attributes.name: disability_type
attributes.description: Classification of the registrant's disability type per Washington Group Short Set categories. Used for targeted accommodation planning, assistive device provision, and inclusive program design. Only populated when has_disability is True. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mobility|vision|hearing|cognitive|psychosocial|multiple|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Washington Group Short Set on Functioning; IASC Disability Inclusion Guidelines; WHO International Classification of Functioning (ICF)

attributes.name: family_name
attributes.description: The registrant's family name or surname as recorded at registration. Combined with given_name for full identity display and deduplication matching.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; UNHCR Data Protection Guidelines; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: given_name
attributes.description: The registrant's given name (first name) as recorded at registration. Used for identity verification, case management, and beneficiary communication.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; UNHCR Data Protection Guidelines; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: has_disability
attributes.description: Indicates whether the registrant has a reported disability. Used for inclusive programming, accessibility accommodations, and Washington Group Short Set disaggregation in MEL reporting per IASC disability inclusion guidelines.
attributes.references: Washington Group Short Set on Functioning; IASC Disability Inclusion Guidelines; CRPD Article 11

attributes.name: is_gbv_survivor
attributes.description: Indicates whether the registrant has been identified as a Gender-Based Violence (GBV) survivor. Triggers GBV case management referral, PSS services, and safe space access. Stored with highest data protection classification per GBV information management principles.
attributes.references: IASC GBV Guidelines; GBV Information Management System (GBVIMS) Standards; UNHCR GBV Data Protection Protocol

attributes.name: is_pregnant_or_lactating
attributes.description: Indicates whether the registrant is a pregnant or lactating woman (PLW). Triggers priority access to nutrition programs (SAM/GAM treatment, supplementary feeding), antenatal care referrals, and PLW-specific NFI kits.
attributes.references: Sphere Association Nutrition Standards; UNHCR Nutrition Guidelines; WHO Infant and Young Child Feeding Standards

attributes.name: is_unaccompanied_minor
attributes.description: Indicates whether the registrant is an unaccompanied or separated child (UASC). Triggers child protection protocols, best-interest assessments, and mandatory referral to child protection case management per UNHCR/UNICEF UASC guidelines.
attributes.references: UNHCR/UNICEF Guidelines on Unaccompanied and Separated Children; CRC Article 20; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS)

attributes.name: last_verification_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent identity or liveness verification for this registrant. Used to flag records requiring re-verification per program cycle requirements and to support active beneficiary count accuracy for donor reporting.
attributes.references: USAID BHA Beneficiary Verification Requirements; UNHCR Registration Quality Assurance; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: muac_cm
attributes.description: Mid-Upper Arm Circumference (MUAC) measurement in centimetres recorded at registration or nutrition screening. Used to classify acute malnutrition status (SAM: <11.5cm, MAM: 11.5–12.5cm) per Sphere/WHO nutrition protocols. Applicable for children 6–59 months and PLW.
attributes.references: WHO/UNICEF/WFP/UNHCR Joint Statement on Community-Based Management of Acute Malnutrition; Sphere Nutrition Standards; GAM/SAM Classification Thresholds

attributes.name: nationality_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the registrant's nationality. Used for protection status determination, IDP/refugee classification, and donor reporting disaggregation.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; UNHCR proGres v4 Nationality Field; IATI Country Code Standard

attributes.name: poc_category
attributes.description: UNHCR-aligned classification of the registrant's protection status as a Person of Concern (PoC). Drives protection programming, legal aid eligibility, and UNHCR/OCHA statistical reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: refugee|idp|returnee|stateless|asylum_seeker|host_community|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: UNHCR Statute; UNHCR proGres v4 PoC Category; OCHA Humanitarian Needs Overview Standards

attributes.name: preferred_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639 language code for the registrant's preferred communication language. Used to assign appropriate interpreters, translated materials, and language-appropriate PSS services. Supports CHS Commitment 4 on accessible communication.
attributes.references: ISO 639 Language Code Standard; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Commitment 4; HAP Communication Standards

attributes.name: protection_flag
attributes.description: Master protection concern flag indicating the registrant has one or more active protection risks (GBV, UASC, trafficking, detention risk, etc.). Triggers protection case management workflow and restricts data sharing per CHS data protection principles.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; UNHCR Protection Monitoring Guidelines; IASC Protection Cluster Standards

attributes.name: re_registration_count
attributes.description: Number of times this registrant has been re-registered in the system (e.g., after displacement, camp relocation, or annual verification cycles). Supports re-registration tracking and historical registration event analysis.
attributes.references: UNHCR Registration Guidelines; WFP SCOPE Re-registration Protocol; USAID BHA Beneficiary Verification Requirements

attributes.name: registration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the registrant was first formally registered into the beneficiary system. Used as the baseline date for program enrollment timelines, cohort analysis, and compliance reporting to donors (USAID BHA, DFID).
attributes.references: IATI Activity Standard; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; USAID ADS Chapter 303

attributes.name: registration_modality
attributes.description: The channel or method through which the registrant was enrolled. Distinguishes in-person field registration, mobile data collection (KoboToolbox/CommCare), remote registration (phone/online), and self-registration kiosks. Informs data quality scoring and verification requirements.
attributes.references: KoboToolbox Field Data Collection Standards; CommCare Mobile Case Management; UNHCR Registration Guidelines

attributes.name: registration_source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this registrant record originated. Supports data lineage, deduplication across systems, and interoperability mapping to UNHCR proGres v4, WFP SCOPE, and RAIS.
attributes.references: IATI Data Transparency Standard; CommCare Integration Specification; KoboToolbox API Documentation

attributes.name: registration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the registrant record. Controls eligibility for program services, NFI distributions, and case management workflows. 'Duplicate' status is set by the deduplication process; 'departed' indicates the individual has left the program area.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; UNHCR proGres v4 Case Status; CommCare Case Status

attributes.name: registration_tool
attributes.description: The specific data collection tool or form used to capture the registration. Distinguishes KoboToolbox survey forms, CommCare mobile case forms, paper-based forms, and direct system entry. Informs data quality and field validation rules.
attributes.references: KoboToolbox Field Data Collection Standards; CommCare Mobile Case Management; ICT4D Best Practices

attributes.name: registration_type
attributes.description: Classifies the registrant as an individual, household head, household member, or community-level registration. Determines the unit of analysis for program targeting, NFI distribution, and beneficiary counting methodologies.
attributes.references: UNHCR proGres v4 Registration Type; WFP SCOPE Beneficiary Classification; Sphere Association Standards

attributes.name: sex
attributes.description: Biological sex of the registrant as recorded at registration. Used for DAC-compliant gender disaggregation in MEL reporting, GBV protection screening, and SPHERE-aligned needs assessments.
attributes.references: OECD DAC Gender Equality Marker; UNHCR Age and Gender Disaggregation Policy; IASC Gender Handbook

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating source system (e.g., CommCare case_id, KoboToolbox submission UUID, proGres v4 individual_id). Enables bidirectional traceability and re-synchronization with operational systems.
attributes.references: CommCare Case Management API; KoboToolbox Submission API; UNHCR proGres v4 Data Dictionary

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this registrant record in the data platform. Used for incremental data processing, change data capture, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: verification_document_number
attributes.description: The document number from the identity verification document presented at registration (e.g., national ID number, passport number, UNHCR card number). Stored encrypted; used for deduplication and re-registration identity matching.
attributes.references: UNHCR Data Protection Guidelines; GDPR Article 9; USAID BHA Beneficiary Verification Requirements

attributes.name: verification_document_type
attributes.description: Type of identity verification document presented at registration. Used for identity assurance scoring, fraud prevention, and compliance with donor KYB (Know Your Beneficiary) requirements. 'Community attestation' applies where formal documents are unavailable.
attributes.references: UNHCR Registration Guidelines; USAID BHA Beneficiary Verification Requirements; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: vulnerability_category
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the registrant's vulnerability level derived from the vulnerability_score. Drives program targeting decisions, priority service access, and donor reporting on most-vulnerable population coverage.
attributes.references: UNHCR Vulnerability Assessment Framework; OCHA Humanitarian Needs Overview; DAC Evaluation Criteria

attributes.name: vulnerability_score
attributes.description: Composite vulnerability index score calculated from the needs assessment, capturing food insecurity, protection risks, health status, and displacement severity. Used for program prioritization, targeting, and MEL outcome tracking. Score range and methodology defined per program LogFrame.
attributes.references: UNHCR Vulnerability Assessment Framework; WFP Vulnerability Analysis and Mapping (VAM); IASC Needs Assessment Standards

products.name: household
products.description: Master record for a household unit as the primary unit of registration and service delivery in humanitarian contexts. Captures household composition count, head-of-household reference (FK to registrant), geographic location, community/settlement reference, shelter type, displacement status, and household-level vulnerability indicators. Links individual registrants to their household grouping via household_member association for NFI distribution, WASH assessments, and food security programming. Supports WFP SCOPE household registration and UNHCR proGres family composition interoperability.
products.reference: UNHCR Household Registration / SPHERE Household Standards

attributes.name: household_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the household record. Primary key for the household master entity in the beneficiary domain. Role: MASTER_AGREEMENT — a household registration is a long-running binding container linking individuals to service delivery.
attributes.references: UNHCR proGres v4 Household Registration Standard; WFP SCOPE Household Registration

attributes.name: country_office_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to field.country_office. Business justification: Country offices manage household registration, vulnerability management, and produce household-level statistics for HRP and donor reporting. Household records must be attributed to the managing countr

attributes.name: emergency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to field.emergency. Business justification: Households are registered or displaced due to specific emergencies. Emergency response planning, flash appeal reporting, and targeted beneficiary counts require knowing which households are affected b

attributes.name: intervention_id
attributes.description: Reference to the programme under which this household was registered and is receiving services. Links to the programme master product in the Program domain for LogFrame, Theory of Change, and donor grant alignment.
attributes.references: IATI Activity Standard; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200; USAID ADS Chapter 201

attributes.name: partner_org_id
attributes.description: Reference to the community or settlement record where the household is located. Supports geographic aggregation for WASH assessments, food security cluster reporting, and GIS-based programme planning via Humanitarian OpenStreetMap.
attributes.references: OCHA Common Operational Datasets; Humanitarian OpenStreetMap; IATI Location Standard

attributes.name: project_site_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to field.project_site. Business justification: Households are registered and served at specific field locations. Critical for household-level service delivery tracking, geographic targeting analysis, and site-based program planning. Standard pract

attributes.name: target_population_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to program.target_population. Business justification: Household-level targeting: NGOs assess households against target_population criteria (displacement_status, vulnerability_category, geographic_scope) to determine program eligibility. Household targeti

attributes.name: admin1_name
attributes.description: Name of the first-level administrative division (region, province, or state) where the household is located. Aligns with OCHA Common Operational Datasets (CODs) administrative boundary layer 1 for GIS mapping and cluster reporting.
attributes.references: OCHA Common Operational Datasets (CODs); Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Admin Boundaries; IATI Location Standard

attributes.name: admin2_name
attributes.description: Name of the second-level administrative division (district, county, or department) where the household is located. Used for sub-national programme targeting, cluster coordination, and DHIS2 geographic disaggregation.
attributes.references: OCHA Common Operational Datasets (CODs); DHIS2 Organisation Unit Hierarchy; Humanitarian OpenStreetMap

attributes.name: children_under5_count
attributes.description: Number of children aged 0–4 years in the household. Critical for nutrition programme targeting (Global Acute Malnutrition / Severe Acute Malnutrition screening), UNICEF child protection reporting, and SPHERE minimum standards for child-specific NFI distributions.
attributes.references: SPHERE Humanitarian Standards; UNICEF Child Protection; WHO GAM/SAM Screening Protocols; DHIS2 Nutrition Indicators

attributes.name: commcare_case_reference
attributes.description: Unique case identifier from CommCare mobile case management system for this household. Enables bidirectional synchronisation between the lakehouse silver layer and CommCare for community health worker follow-up, beneficiary tracking, and case status updates.
attributes.references: CommCare Case Management API; Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits Integration; CHS Commitment 5

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: Date on which informed consent was obtained from the head of household. Required for GDPR data processing records, CHS accountability documentation, and audit trails for data protection compliance reviews.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 (Conditions for Consent); CHS Commitment 4; HAP Standard; ICRC Data Protection in Humanitarian Action

attributes.name: consent_obtained
attributes.description: Indicates whether informed consent for data collection and processing was obtained from the head of household at the time of registration. Mandatory for GDPR compliance, CHS Commitment 4 accountability, and HAP Standard data protection requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 & 7; CHS Commitment 4; HAP Standard; ICRC Data Protection in Humanitarian Action

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the household's country of origin or habitual residence prior to displacement. Required for UNHCR refugee population statistics, OCHA Humanitarian Response Plan disaggregation, and IATI geographic coding.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; UNHCR Population Statistics; IATI Country Code Standard

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the household record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit trail creation marker for data governance, GDPR data processing records, and silver layer lineage tracking in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30 (Records of Processing); FASB ASC 958; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 Record Retention

attributes.name: current_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country where the household is currently residing. Used for cross-border programme coordination, OCHA SitRep geographic disaggregation, and IATI location reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; IATI Location Standard; OCHA Common Operational Datasets

attributes.name: deregistration_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the household exited or was closed from the programme. Nullable for active households. Used to calculate programme duration, exit analysis, and MEL outcome tracking. Corresponds to the effective-until date of the household registration agreement.
attributes.references: UNHCR proGres v4 Case Closure; IATI Activity Standard; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: displacement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the household was displaced from their place of habitual residence. Used for durable solutions planning, return and reintegration programming, and UNHCR proGres displacement history tracking.
attributes.references: UNHCR proGres v4 Displacement History; Guiding Principles on Internal Displacement; OCHA IDP Monitoring

attributes.name: displacement_status
attributes.description: Classification of the household's displacement situation. Internally Displaced Person (IDP), refugee, returnee, host community, stateless, or asylum seeker. Determines eligibility for specific UNHCR, OCHA, and WFP programme streams and drives proGres v4 population group assignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: idp|refugee|returnee|host_community|stateless|asylum_seeker — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: UNHCR Refugee Status Determination; OCHA IDP Tracking; 1951 Refugee Convention; Guiding Principles on Internal Displacement

attributes.name: elderly_count
attributes.description: Number of household members aged 60 years or older. Used for vulnerability scoring, priority targeting in food security and health programmes, and age-disaggregated donor reporting per OCHA and IASC standards.
attributes.references: IASC Age and Disability Disaggregation; OCHA Humanitarian Response Plan; HelpAge International Standards

attributes.name: exit_reason
attributes.description: Reason for the household's exit or closure from the programme. Used for MEL outcome analysis, durable solutions tracking, and donor reporting on programme completion rates. Nullable for active households. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: graduated|relocated|deceased|voluntary_withdrawal|ineligible|duplicate|lost_to_followup — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: UNHCR Durable Solutions Framework; WFP Programme Exit Strategy; USAID BHA Closeout Guidelines; CHS Commitment 6

attributes.name: female_count
attributes.description: Number of female individuals in the household. Required for sex-disaggregated reporting to OCHA, USAID, and DFID donors. Supports gender analysis in MEL frameworks and IASC gender marker compliance.
attributes.references: IASC Gender Marker; OCHA Humanitarian Response Plan; USAID ADS 205 Gender Equality

attributes.name: food_security_status
attributes.description: Household-level food security classification based on the Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) or Household Food Insecurity Access Scale (HFIAS). Drives WFP food assistance targeting, cash transfer programme eligibility, and OCHA food security cluster reporting.
attributes.references: IPC Global Partners Food Security Classification; WFP SCOPE Food Security; FEWS NET; OCHA Food Security Cluster

attributes.name: gbv_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household has been identified as at elevated risk of or affected by Gender-Based Violence (GBV). Classified restricted due to sensitivity. Triggers referral to GBV case management, PSS (Psychosocial Support) services, and safe space programming. Access strictly controlled per GBV information management protocols.
attributes.references: IASC GBV Guidelines; GBV Information Management System (GBVIMS); UNHCR GBV Standard Operating Procedures; CHS Commitment 3

attributes.name: gps_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the household's physical location in decimal degrees (WGS84). Captured via KoboToolbox GPS widget during field registration. Used for GIS mapping, proximity analysis, and Humanitarian OpenStreetMap integration. Classified confidential as precise location of vulnerable individuals.
attributes.references: WGS84 Coordinate Reference System; Humanitarian OpenStreetMap; KoboToolbox GPS Standard; OCHA GIS Guidelines

attributes.name: gps_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the household's physical location in decimal degrees (WGS84). Captured via KoboToolbox GPS widget during field registration. Used for GIS mapping, proximity analysis, and Humanitarian OpenStreetMap integration. Classified confidential as precise location of vulnerable individuals.
attributes.references: WGS84 Coordinate Reference System; Humanitarian OpenStreetMap; KoboToolbox GPS Standard; OCHA GIS Guidelines

attributes.name: has_pregnant_lactating
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pregnant or Lactating Woman Present Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household includes at least one pregnant or lactating woman (PLW). Critical flag for nutrition programme targeting (supplementary feeding, micronutrient supplementation), SPHERE nutrition standards compliance, and UNICEF/WFP PLW-specific assistance eligibility.
attributes.references: SPHERE Nutrition Standards; UNICEF PLW Nutrition Guidelines; WFP SCOPE Nutrition Targeting

tag_set.value: Pregnant or Lactating Woman Present Flag

attributes.name: has_unaccompanied_minor
attributes.business_glossary_term: Unaccompanied or Separated Child (UASC) Present Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household includes an unaccompanied or separated child (UASC). Triggers child protection case management protocols in CommCare, UNHCR UASC registration procedures, and UNICEF child protection programme referrals.
attributes.references: UNHCR UASC Guidelines; UNICEF Child Protection; IASC Child Protection Minimum Standards; CRC Article 20

tag_set.value: Unaccompanied or Separated Child (UASC) Present Flag

attributes.name: is_female_headed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the household is headed by a woman. Key targeting criterion for GBV (Gender-Based Violence) prevention programmes, women's economic empowerment initiatives, and IASC gender marker reporting. Required for USAID gender equality disaggregation.
attributes.references: IASC Gender Marker; USAID ADS 205 Gender Equality; UN Women Programming Principles; OCHA Gender in Humanitarian Action

attributes.name: kobo_submission_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the KoboToolbox form submission that created or last updated this household record. Enables traceability back to the original field data collection form for data quality audits, MEAL verification, and source system reconciliation.
attributes.references: KoboToolbox Form Submission Metadata; OCHA Field Data Collection Standards; CHS Commitment 5 Data Quality

attributes.name: last_assessment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent household-level needs assessment or vulnerability re-assessment conducted. Used to identify households overdue for reassessment, track MEL data currency, and ensure programme targeting reflects current conditions per MEAL cycle requirements.
attributes.references: OCHA Needs Assessment Framework; IASC Needs Assessment Task Force; CHS Commitment 5; USAID MEL Policy

attributes.name: male_count
attributes.description: Number of male individuals in the household. Required for sex-disaggregated reporting to OCHA, USAID, and DFID donors. Supports gender analysis in MEL frameworks and IASC gender marker compliance.
attributes.references: IASC Gender Marker; OCHA Humanitarian Response Plan; USAID ADS 205 Gender Equality

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for field staff to record contextual observations, special circumstances, or case management notes about the household that do not fit structured fields. Classified confidential due to potential sensitivity of recorded information. Supports CommCare case notes and KoboToolbox open-text responses.
attributes.references: CHS Commitment 4 (Accountability); HAP Standard; ICRC Data Protection in Humanitarian Action

attributes.name: pwd_count
attributes.description: Number of household members with a physical, sensory, intellectual, or psychosocial disability. Required for IASC disability inclusion reporting, Washington Group Short Set disaggregation, and inclusive programming compliance under the CRPD.
attributes.references: IASC Guidelines on Inclusion of Persons with Disabilities; Washington Group Short Set on Functioning; UN CRPD

attributes.name: registration_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the household was first formally registered into the programme. Serves as the effective start date of the household agreement with the organisation. Used for cohort analysis, programme duration calculations, and donor reporting.
attributes.references: UNHCR proGres v4; WFP SCOPE; IATI Activity Standard

attributes.name: registration_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code assigned to the household at point of registration. Used across field operations, NFI distribution lists, WASH assessments, and food security programming as the primary cross-system reference. Corresponds to the SCOPE household token or proGres case number.
attributes.references: UNHCR proGres v4; WFP SCOPE; IATI Beneficiary Identifier Standard

attributes.name: registration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the household registration. Active indicates the household is enrolled and eligible for services. Suspended indicates a temporary hold pending verification. Closed indicates the household has exited programming. Drives eligibility checks in CommCare and Microsoft Dynamics 365 case management.
attributes.references: UNHCR proGres v4 Case Status; CHS Core Humanitarian Standard Commitment 1; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200

attributes.name: registration_type
attributes.description: Classification of the registration event that created or last updated this household record. Distinguishes initial intake from periodic re-verification exercises required by UNHCR and WFP programme cycles.
attributes.references: UNHCR proGres v4 Registration Type Codes; CHS Commitment 4

attributes.name: sanitation_facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the household's primary sanitation facility. Core WASH indicator for SPHERE minimum standards, OCHA WASH cluster reporting, and WHO/UNICEF Joint Monitoring Programme (JMP) SDG 6 tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: flush_toilet|pit_latrine|ventilated_pit|open_defecation|communal_latrine|none — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: membership_end_date

attributes.name: geographic_area_code

Used for cash and voucher assistance (CVA) targeting.

attributes.name: next_reassessment_date

attributes.name: nutritional_status

attributes.references: WHO Nutrition Guidelines for PLW; SPHERE Nutrition Standards; UNICEF CMAM Protocol

attributes.name: protection_risk_level
attributes.description: Assessed level of protection risk for the individual or household, encompassing threats of violence, exploitation, abuse, and discrimination. Classified by a trained protection officer. Drives case prioritization and referral pathways per UNHCR Protection Framework.
attributes.references: UNHCR Protection Framework; IASC Protection Cluster Guidelines; CHS Alliance

attributes.name: pss_need_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the beneficiary has been assessed as requiring Psychosocial Support (PSS) services, including mental health support, trauma counselling, or community-based psychosocial activities. Triggers referral to PSS programming.
attributes.references: IASC Guidelines on Mental Health and Psychosocial Support (MHPSS); WHO mhGAP

attributes.name: shelter_adequacy
attributes.description: Assessment of the beneficiary's shelter situation against SPHERE minimum standards. 'none' indicates no shelter; 'inadequate' indicates shelter below minimum standards; 'transitional' indicates temporary/emergency shelter; 'adequate' indicates shelter meeting minimum standards. Drives NFI and shelter program targeting.
attributes.references: SPHERE Shelter and Settlement Standards; UNHCR Shelter Guidelines

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: Indicates the operational process or event that triggered the creation or update of this vulnerability profile. 'post_distribution_monitoring' refers to Post-Distribution Monitoring (PDM) assessments; 'emergency_screening' refers to rapid assessments during acute crises. Used for MEL data quality analysis.
attributes.references: OCHA Needs Assessment Guidelines; IASC Operational Guidance on PDM; MEAL Framework

attributes.name: unaccompanied_minor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the beneficiary is an unaccompanied or separated child (UASC) — a child under 18 separated from both parents and other relatives and not being cared for by a responsible adult. Triggers child protection case management and family tracing and reunification (FTR) services.
attributes.references: UNHCR/UNICEF Guidelines on Unaccompanied and Separated Children; CRC Article 20; IASC Child Protection

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vulnerability profile was last modified, reflecting the most recent update to any vulnerability indicator. Triggers downstream re-targeting and prioritization workflows.
attributes.references: IATI Data Standard; Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance

attributes.name: vulnerability_profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the vulnerability profile record. 'active' indicates the current consolidated vulnerability state; 'superseded' indicates a newer profile has replaced this one; 'pending_review' indicates awaiting validation by a protection or MEL officer.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance; CommCare Case Status Lifecycle

attributes.name: vulnerability_tier
attributes.description: Categorical tier derived from the composite vulnerability score, used for operational targeting and prioritization decisions. 'critical' indicates immediate life-saving intervention required; 'high' indicates priority program enrollment; 'medium' and 'low' indicate standard program eligibility. Distinct from composite_vulnerability_score which is the numeric value.
attributes.references: OCHA HNO Severity Classification; IASC Needs Assessment Framework

attributes.name: wash_access_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Water Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH) Access Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the beneficiary household has adequate access to safe water, sanitation, and hygiene (WASH) facilities meeting SPHERE minimum standards. False indicates a WASH vulnerability requiring intervention. Used for WASH sector targeting and OCHA cluster reporting.
attributes.references: SPHERE WASH Standards; UNICEF/WHO Joint Monitoring Programme (JMP); OCHA WASH Cluster

tag_set.value: Water Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH) Access Flag

products.name: needs_assessment
products.description: Transactional record of a formal needs assessment conducted for an individual beneficiary, household, or community to determine eligibility, vulnerability level, and appropriate service referrals. Captures assessment date, assessment level (individual, household, community), assessment type (initial registration assessment, periodic reassessment, post-crisis rapid assessment, sector-specific deep assessment), sectors assessed (WASH, nutrition, shelter, protection, livelihoods, education), assessment tool identifier (KoboToolbox form ID, CommCare module), field enumerator, geographic coordinates, and scored findings per sector. Owned by beneficiary domain as it determines beneficiary status and targeting — distinct from MEL post-distribution monitoring which measures program effectiveness. Assessment findings feed into vulnerability_profile updates when they materially change vulnerability classification.
products.reference: KoboToolbox Needs Assessment / OCHA Humanitarian Needs Overview (HNO)

attributes.name: needs_assessment_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each needs assessment record. Primary key for the needs_assessment data product within the beneficiary domain.
attributes.references: Core Humanitarian Standard (CHS) Alliance — Data Management Principles

attributes.name: assessment_id
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the data collection instrument used to conduct this assessment. For KoboToolbox, this is the form UID (e.g., 'aXmK3p9QrT'). For CommCare, this is the module ID. Enables traceability back to the specific questionnaire version and supports data quality audits.
attributes.references: KoboToolbox Form Management — Form UID; CommCare Application Builder — Module ID

attributes.name: household_id

attributes.name: intervention_id
attributes.description: Reference to the humanitarian or development program under which this needs assessment was commissioned. Links the assessment to the program's Theory of Change (ToC) and LogFrame targeting criteria.
attributes.references: Microsoft Dynamics 365 for Nonprofits — Program Management Module; IATI Standard v2.03

attributes.name: partner_org_id

attributes.name: registrant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual beneficiary (IDP, PoC, GBV survivor, or other target population member) who is the subject of this assessment when assessment_level is 'individual'. Nullable when assessment_level is 'household' or 'community'.

attributes.name: reporting_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mel.reporting_period. Business justification: Needs assessments are scheduled as baseline, midline, and endline exercises aligned to MEL reporting periods. This link enables MEL teams to track vulnerability score changes across periods and report

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to volunteer.volunteer_deployment. Links assessment data to the event context,

Adding vulnerability_profile_id to beneficiary_needs_assessment captures the direct relations

attributes.name: admin1_name
attributes.description: Name of the first-level administrative division (e.g., province, state, region) where the assessment was conducted. Sourced from OCHA Common Operational Datasets (CODs) administrative boundary reference. Used for geographic aggregation in SitReps and donor reports.
attributes.references: OCHA Common Operational Datasets (CODs) — Administrative Boundaries; IATI Country/Region Codes

attributes.name: admin2_name
attributes.description: Name of the second-level administrative division (e.g., district, county, department) where the assessment was conducted. Sourced from OCHA CODs. Enables sub-national geographic disaggregation for targeting and cluster coordination reporting.
attributes.references: OCHA Common Operational Datasets (CODs) — Administrative Boundaries

attributes.name: beneficiary_needs_assessment_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the needs assessment was physically conducted in the field. This is the principal real-world event date, distinct from the record submission or validation timestamps. Used for temporal targeting analysis and periodic reassessment scheduling.
attributes.references: SPHERE Handbook — Needs Assessment Timing; OCHA Assessment Registry Standards

attributes.name: beneficiary_needs_assessment_level
attributes.description: The unit of analysis at which this needs assessment was conducted. 'individual' targets a single beneficiary (e.g., GBV survivor, SAM case); 'household' targets a family unit; 'community' targets a settlement or geographic cluster. Determines which of beneficiary_id, household_id, or community_id is populated.
attributes.references: SPHERE Handbook Chapter 1 — Needs Assessment Methodology; IASC Needs Assessment Task Force Guidelines

attributes.name: beneficiary_needs_assessment_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle state of the needs assessment record. 'draft' indicates field data entry in progress; 'submitted' indicates enumerator submission pending review; 'validated' indicates supervisor-approved and usable for targeting; 'rejected' indicates data quality failure requiring re-assessment.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Data Quality Standards; KoboToolbox Submission Workflow

attributes.name: beneficiary_needs_assessment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the assessment's purpose and methodology. 'initial_registration' is conducted at first beneficiary contact; 'periodic_reassessment' is a scheduled follow-up to update vulnerability status; 'post_crisis_rapid' is an emergency rapid assessment following a shock event; 'sector_specific_deep' is an in-depth assessment for a single sector (e.g., nutrition MUAC screening, WASH facility survey).
attributes.references: IASC Needs Assessment Task Force — Assessment Types Taxonomy; OCHA Assessment Registry

attributes.name: children_under5_count
attributes.description: Number of children under 5 years of age in the assessed household. Key vulnerability indicator for nutrition (SAM/GAM screening), WASH (diarrhoea risk), and child protection programming. Required for UNICEF and WFP programme targeting.
attributes.references: UNICEF Child Vulnerability Standards; SPHERE Handbook — Nutrition (Under-5 Focus); WFP Targeting Criteria

attributes.name: consent_obtained
attributes.description: Indicates whether informed consent was obtained from the beneficiary or household head prior to conducting the assessment. Mandatory per CHS Commitment 4 (Accountability to Affected Populations) and GDPR Article 6 for data processing lawfulness. Must be TRUE for the record to be validated.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Commitment 4 Accountability; GDPR Article 6 Lawful Basis; HAP Standard

attributes.name: consent_type
attributes.description: The form of informed consent obtained. 'verbal' is spoken consent recorded by enumerator; 'written' is signed consent form; 'proxy' is consent given by a guardian or community leader on behalf of a vulnerable individual (e.g., child, person with disability). Relevant for legal compliance and data protection audits.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7 — Conditions for Consent; CHS Alliance Data Protection Guidelines; ICRC Data Protection in Humanitarian Action

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the assessment was conducted (e.g., 'SOM', 'SSD', 'HTI'). Used for IATI reporting, donor country-level aggregation, and cross-country comparative analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; IATI Standard v2.03 — Country Code

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this needs assessment record was first created in the data platform (Silver layer ingestion timestamp). Distinct from assessment_date (field event date). Used for data pipeline monitoring and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: FASB ASC 958 — Record Keeping; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200 — Documentation Requirements

attributes.name: data_collection_method
attributes.description: The primary method used to gather assessment data. 'face_to_face' is direct in-person interview; 'remote_phone' is telephone-based; 'fgd' is a Focus Group Discussion (FGD); 'kii' is a Key Informant Interview (KII); 'observation' is direct field observation without interview; 'secondary_data' is derived from existing records. Affects data quality weighting in vulnerability scoring.
attributes.references: IASC Needs Assessment Task Force — Data Collection Methodology; SPHERE Handbook

attributes.name: displacement_status
attributes.description: The displacement classification of the assessed individual or household at the time of assessment. 'idp' = Internally Displaced Person (IDP); 'refugee' = person with international protection status; 'returnee' = person returning to place of origin; 'host_community' = non-displaced community member hosting displaced persons. Critical for UNHCR/OCHA population movement tracking.
attributes.references: UNHCR Refugee Definition (1951 Convention); OCHA IDP Tracking Matrix (DTM); Guiding Principles on Internal Displacement

attributes.name: education_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for the education sector assessment findings. Null if education was not included in sectors_assessed. Covers school access, enrollment barriers, learning environment safety, and teacher availability against SPHERE/INEE minimum standards.
attributes.references: SPHERE Handbook — Education; INEE Minimum Standards for Education in Emergencies; IASC Education Cluster

attributes.name: enumerator_notes
attributes.description: Free-text qualitative observations recorded by the field enumerator during the assessment. Captures contextual information not covered by structured questions (e.g., security constraints, access limitations, observed conditions). Used by supervisors during validation review.
attributes.references: KoboToolbox — Note Question Type; CommCare — Case Note Field; CHS Alliance Data Quality Standards

attributes.name: female_headed_household
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assessed household is headed by a female. Female-headed households are a standard vulnerability marker in humanitarian targeting criteria and are required for gender disaggregation in donor reports (USAID, DFID/FCDO, UN Women standards).
attributes.references: USAID Gender Equality and Female Empowerment Policy; UN Women Humanitarian Action; IASC Gender Marker

attributes.name: gbv_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assessment identified elevated Gender-Based Violence (GBV) risk for the assessed individual or household. When TRUE, triggers referral to GBV case management pathway and PSS services. Classified as restricted PHI due to extreme sensitivity of GBV disclosure data.
attributes.references: IASC GBV Guidelines; UNHCR GBVIMS Data Protection Protocol; SPHERE Handbook — Protection Principles

attributes.name: gps_accuracy_meters
attributes.description: Estimated GPS accuracy in meters at the time of coordinate capture, as reported by the mobile device. KoboToolbox and CommCare record this automatically. Values above 30 meters may indicate unreliable location data and trigger data quality flags.
attributes.references: KoboToolbox GPS Question Type — Accuracy Field; Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Data Quality Standards

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate (WGS84 decimal degrees) of the assessment location captured by the field enumerator's device via KoboToolbox or CommCare GPS capture. Used for GIS mapping, cluster analysis, and geographic targeting in humanitarian response planning.
attributes.references: Humanitarian OpenStreetMap — WGS84 Coordinate Standard; OCHA GIS Standards

attributes.name: livelihoods_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for the livelihoods sector assessment findings. Null if livelihoods was not included in sectors_assessed. Covers income sources, asset ownership, market access, and economic vulnerability indicators.
attributes.references: SPHERE Handbook — Livelihoods; IASC Livelihoods Cluster Assessment Framework; USAID BHA Livelihoods Assessment Standards

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate (WGS84 decimal degrees) of the assessment location captured by the field enumerator's device. Used alongside latitude for GIS mapping, spatial clustering, and geographic targeting in humanitarian response planning.
attributes.references: Humanitarian OpenStreetMap — WGS84 Coordinate Standard; OCHA GIS Standards

attributes.name: muac_mm
attributes.description: Mid-Upper Arm Circumference (MUAC) measurement in millimetres for children under 5 or pregnant/lactating women, used to screen for acute malnutrition. MUAC < 115mm indicates SAM; 115–125mm indicates MAM. Classified as PHI as it is a direct health measurement linked to an individual. Null if not applicable to assessment subject.
attributes.references: WHO MUAC Screening Protocol; SPHERE Handbook — Nutrition; UNICEF MUAC Standards

attributes.name: nutrition_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for the nutrition sector assessment findings. Null if nutrition was not included in sectors_assessed. Incorporates Global Acute Malnutrition (GAM) and Severe Acute Malnutrition (SAM) indicators where applicable. Feeds into DHIS2 nutrition indicator tracking.
attributes.references: SPHERE Handbook — Nutrition Chapter; WHO/UNICEF GAM/SAM Thresholds; DHIS2 Nutrition Indicators

attributes.name: overall_vulnerability_score
attributes.description: Composite numeric score representing the assessed subject's overall vulnerability level, calculated from sector-specific findings using the program's scoring methodology (e.g., 0–100 scale). Feeds into vulnerability_profile updates when the score materially changes vulnerability classification. This is a raw assessment output, not a derived KPI.
attributes.references: IASC Needs Assessment Task Force — Vulnerability Scoring; UNHCR Vulnerability Assessment Framework

attributes.name: persons_with_disability_count
attributes.description: Number of household members with a physical, sensory, intellectual, or psychosocial disability. Required for disability-inclusive programming per IASC Guidelines on Inclusion of Persons with Disabilities in Humanitarian Action and CRPD compliance reporting.
attributes.references: IASC Guidelines on Inclusion of Persons with Disabilities; UN CRPD; Washington Group Short Set on Disability

attributes.name: protection_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for the protection sector assessment findings. Null if protection was not included in sectors_assessed. Covers GBV risk, child protection, housing land and property rights, and documentation status. Sensitive findings are handled per GBV information management protocols.
attributes.references: IASC Protection Cluster — Assessment Standards; UNHCR GBV Information Management System (GBVIMS); SPHERE Handbook — Protection Principles

attributes.name: reference_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference code assigned to this needs assessment, used in field reports, SitReps, and donor communications. Format: NA-{COUNTRY}-{YEAR}-{SEQUENCE}. Sourced from KoboToolbox or CommCare submission ID.
attributes.references: IATI Standard v2.03 — Activity Identifier; KoboToolbox Form Submission Reference

attributes.name: referral_recommended
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assessment findings recommend referral of the beneficiary or household to one or more service providers or program interventions. When TRUE, a referral pathway is initiated in CommCare case management. Drives downstream case management workflow.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Commitment 3 (Referral Pathways); CommCare Case Management Referral Module

attributes.name: referral_sectors
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of sectors to which the beneficiary or household is being referred based on assessment findings (e.g., 'nutrition|PSS|WASH'). Populated only when referral_recommended is TRUE. Drives service pathway activation in CommCare and Microsoft Dynamics 365 case management.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Commitment 3 (Referral Pathways); IASC Cluster Referral Protocols; CommCare Referral Module

attributes.name: sectors_assessed
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of humanitarian/development sectors covered in this assessment (e.g., 'WASH|nutrition|shelter|protection|livelihoods|education'). Sectors align with IASC cluster system. Determines which sector-specific scored findings fields are populated. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WASH|nutrition|shelter|protection|livelihoods|education|health|food_security|NFI|PSS — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IASC Cluster System — Sector Taxonomy; SPHERE Handbook — Sector Chapters; OCHA Cluster Coordination

attributes.name: shelter_score
attributes.description: Numeric score for the shelter sector assessment findings. Null if shelter was not included in sectors_assessed. Assessed against SPHERE minimum standards for covered living space, structural safety, and thermal comfort.
attributes.references: SPHERE Handbook — Shelter and Settlement Chapter; IASC Shelter Cluster Assessment Standards

attributes.name: source_submission_reference
attributes.description: The native submission or case ID from the originating source system (KoboToolbox submission UUID or CommCare case ID). Enables exact record traceability back to the source system for data reconciliation, duplicate detection, and audit purposes.
attributes.references: KoboToolbox API — Submission UUID; CommCare API — Case ID; Databricks Silver Layer Lineage

attributes.name: supervisor_validation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the supervising data manager or MEL officer during the assessment review and validation process. Documents reasons for rejection, data quality concerns, or approval rationale. Populated when assessment_status transitions to 'validated' or 'rejected'.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Data Quality and Accountability Standards; MEAL Framework — Data Verification Protocols

attributes.name: tool_version
attributes.description: Version number or deployment date of the assessment tool/form used. Critical for longitudinal comparability — when a KoboToolbox form or CommCare module is updated, findings from different versions may not be directly comparable without version-aware analysis.
attributes.references: KoboToolbox Form Versioning; IASC Needs Assessment Task Force — Comparability Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this needs assessment record was most recently modified in the data platform. Tracks post-ingestion corrections, validation status changes, and supervisor note additions. Required for Silver layer change data capture (CDC) processing.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer — CDC Standards; CHS Alliance Data Management Principles

attributes.name: validation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the assessment record was validated or rejected by the supervising staff member. Distinct from assessment_date (field event) and created_timestamp (record creation). Used for SLA monitoring of data quality review turnaround.
attributes.references: CHS Alliance — Data Quality Standards; MEAL Framework

attributes.name: vulnerability_category
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the assessed subject's vulnerability level derived from the overall_vulnerability_score and program-specific thresholds. Used for beneficiary targeting, prioritization, and service referral decisions. 'critical' triggers immediate case management escalation.
attributes.references: UNHCR Vulnerability Assessment Framework; IASC Needs Assessment Task Force — Vulnerability Classification

attributes.name: wash_score
attributes.business_glossary_term: Water Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH) Sector Score
attributes.description: Numeric score for the Water, Sanitation and Hygiene (WASH) sector assessment findings. Null if WASH was not included in sectors_assessed. Scored against SPHERE minimum standards for water access, sanitation facilities, and hygiene promotion.
attributes.references: SPHERE Handbook — WASH Chapter; IASC WASH Cluster Assessment Standards

attributes.name: is_child_case
attributes.description: Indicates whether the beneficiary is a child (under 18 years of age). Triggers child protection protocols, guardian consent requirements, and UNICEF/child protection cluster reporting obligations.
attributes.references: UN Convention on the Rights of the Child (CRC); IASC Child Protection Guidelines; UNICEF Child Protection Standards

attributes.name: is_gbv_case
attributes.description: Indicates whether this case involves Gender-Based Violence (GBV). Enables secure, disaggregated GBV caseload reporting while maintaining strict data protection protocols per IASC GBV guidelines.
attributes.references: IASC GBV Guidelines; UNFPA GBV Information Management System (GBVIMS); GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: is_idp_case
attributes.description: Indicates whether the beneficiary is an Internally Displaced Person (IDP). Used for OCHA displacement tracking, Cluster reporting, and disaggregated humanitarian response analysis.
attributes.references: UN Guiding Principles on Internal Displacement; OCHA IDP Tracking; UNHCR PoC Registration

attributes.name: last_followup_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent caseworker interaction or follow-up visit recorded for this case. Used to identify inactive cases and trigger escalation workflows.
attributes.references: CommCare Beneficiary Follow-up; CHS Commitment 4 — Timely Assistance

attributes.name: legal_aid_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the beneficiary requires legal aid services as part of the case management plan (e.g., documentation, asylum claims, GBV legal redress). Triggers referral to legal service providers.
attributes.references: UNHCR Legal Aid Standards; IASC Protection Cluster Guidelines; CHS Commitment 4

attributes.name: muac_cm
attributes.description: Mid-Upper Arm Circumference (MUAC) measurement in centimetres recorded at case intake for nutrition cases. Used to classify Severe Acute Malnutrition (SAM) and Global Acute Malnutrition (GAM) per SPHERE/WHO thresholds. Applicable to nutrition case types only.
attributes.references: SPHERE Nutrition Standards; WHO MUAC Thresholds; UNICEF SAM/GAM Classification; USAID BHA Nutrition Reporting

attributes.name: next_followup_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next planned caseworker interaction or home visit. Drives field scheduling and caseload management in CommCare.
attributes.references: CommCare Case Management Scheduling; IASC Case Management Guidelines

attributes.name: nutrition_status
attributes.description: Classified nutritional status of the beneficiary based on MUAC and/or weight-for-height z-score. SAM = Severe Acute Malnutrition; MAM = Moderate Acute Malnutrition. Drives therapeutic feeding program enrollment and DHIS2 health indicator reporting.
attributes.references: SPHERE Nutrition Minimum Standards; WHO/UNICEF SAM/GAM Protocols; DHIS2 Health Indicator Tracking; USAID BHA GAM Reporting

attributes.name: on_hold_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason explaining why the case has been placed on hold (e.g., beneficiary unreachable, security access constraints, awaiting referral response). Populated only when case_status = on_hold.
attributes.references: CommCare Case Management; IASC Case Management Guidelines

attributes.name: open_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the case was formally opened and registered in the case management system. Used for caseload aging analysis and response time measurement.
attributes.references: CommCare Case Management; OCHA Humanitarian Response Monitoring

attributes.name: outcome_classification
attributes.description: Standardized classification of the case result at closure. Used for MEL outcome reporting, donor accountability, and Theory of Change (ToC) validation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: goal_achieved|partially_achieved|not_achieved|lost_to_followup|referred_out|deceased — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IASC Results-Based Management (RBM); IATI Result Standard; DAC Evaluation Criteria

attributes.name: presenting_issue
attributes.description: Primary issue or need presented by the beneficiary at case intake, as documented by the caseworker (e.g., acute malnutrition, GBV incident, displacement, lack of shelter, psychosocial distress).
attributes.references: CommCare Case Intake Form; IASC Needs Assessment Standards; SPHERE Minimum Standards

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Urgency classification assigned to the case based on vulnerability assessment, protection risk, or medical severity. Determines response time SLAs and caseworker allocation.
attributes.references: SPHERE Minimum Standards; IASC GBV Guidelines; SAM/GAM Nutrition Protocols

attributes.name: protection_risk_level
attributes.description: Assessed level of protection risk for the beneficiary at the time of case opening, based on IASC protection risk analysis. Drives escalation protocols and inter-agency coordination.
attributes.references: IASC Protection Cluster Guidelines; UNHCR Protection Risk Assessment Framework

attributes.name: pss_session_count
attributes.description: Number of Psychosocial Support (PSS) sessions attended by the beneficiary under this case. Used for MEL output tracking, minimum dose compliance, and donor reporting on PSS program reach.
attributes.references: IASC MHPSS Guidelines; SPHERE Mental Health Standards; USAID BHA PSS Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: referral_date
attributes.description: Date on which the beneficiary was referred to an external service or organization. Used to measure referral response time and inter-agency coordination effectiveness.
attributes.references: IASC GBV Referral Pathway Guidelines; CHS Commitment 4

attributes.name: referral_destination
attributes.description: Name or code of the organization, facility, or service to which the beneficiary was referred out from this case (e.g., health clinic, legal aid, shelter). Supports inter-agency referral pathway tracking.
attributes.references: IASC GBV Referral Pathway Guidelines; OCHA Referral Management

attributes.name: referral_source
attributes.description: Channel or entity through which the beneficiary was referred into this case. Used for referral pathway analysis and community outreach effectiveness reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: self_referral|community_referral|health_facility|partner_org|government|hotline|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IASC GBV Referral Pathway Guidelines; CHS Commitment 1

attributes.name: safety_plan_in_place
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal safety plan has been developed and agreed with the beneficiary, particularly for GBV and protection cases. Required element of minimum case management standards.
attributes.references: IASC GBV Case Management Guidelines; UNFPA GBVIMS; CHS Commitment 4

attributes.name: service_modality
attributes.description: Mode of service delivery used for this case (e.g., in-person clinic visit, remote counselling, mobile outreach, group PSS session, home visit). Used for operational planning and cost analysis.
attributes.references: IASC Service Delivery Standards; SPHERE Minimum Standards; ICT4D Field Operations

attributes.name: supervisor_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this case has been flagged for mandatory supervisory review, typically due to critical priority, complex protection risk, or escalation trigger. Supports quality assurance and safeguarding protocols.
attributes.references: CHS Commitment 5 — Complaints and Feedback; IASC GBV Supervision Standards; CommCare Escalation Workflow

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording the most recent modification to the case record. Used for change detection, incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver layer, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(2) — Accountability; OMB Uniform Guidance 2 CFR 200.334; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Capture

attributes.name: vulnerability_score
attributes.description: Composite numeric score derived from the beneficiary needs assessment, reflecting overall vulnerability level (e.g., 0–100 scale). Used for prioritization, targeting, and MEL disaggregation. Higher scores indicate greater vulnerability.
attributes.references: SPHERE Vulnerability Assessment Framework; UNHCR Vulnerability Screening Tool; OCHA Needs Assessment Standards

products.name: enrollment
products.description: This association product represents the enrollment relationship between a registrant and a program component. It captures the operational record of a beneficiary's participation in a specific component of a program intervention, including enrollment lifecycle, service delivery tracking, and component-specific outcome data required for donor reporting and MEL frameworks. Each record links one registrant to one component with attributes that exist only in the context of this enrollment relationship.. Existence Justification: In NGO operations, a single beneficiary registrant participates in multiple program components simultaneously or over time (e.g., a child receives nutrition screening, education support, and WASH services as separate component enrollments). Conversely, each program component serves multiple registrants. The enrollment relationship is actively managed by program staff who track enrollment dates, participation status, attendance, service delivery modality, and exit reasons for each registrant-component pairing. This enrollment data is essential for component-level reach reporting, disaggregated MEL indicators, and donor logframe reporting.

products.name: entitlement
products.description: This association product represents the entitlement relationship between registrant and commodity. It captures the humanitarian assistance entitlement rules that define which commodities each beneficiary is entitled to receive, in what quantities, at what frequency, and for what duration. Each record links one registrant to one commodity with entitlement-specific parameters including quantity per distribution cycle, distribution frequency, entitlement validity period, vulnerability-based adjustments, and special dietary requirements. This is the operational SSOT for ration planning, distribution planning, and beneficiary entitlement verification in food security and NFI distribution programs.. Existence Justification: In humanitarian operations, beneficiaries are entitled to receive multiple commodities simultaneously as part of their assistance package (e.g., a monthly food basket includes rice, oil, beans, salt, and a household receives multiple NFI items like blankets, jerry cans, soap). Each commodity is entitled to thousands of beneficiaries across the program. The entitlement relationship is an operational business entity actively managed by program officers, carrying specific data about quantity per distribution cycle, frequency, validity period, vulnerability-based adjustments, and special dietary requirements that belong to neither the beneficiary nor the commodity alone.

Captures the full program lifecycle from design through closeout, including program type (emergency vs. development), phase, status, start/end dates, geographic scope, target population summary, organizational ownership, and SDG alignment mappings (goal, target, indicator, alignment type, contribution narrative). This is the primary anchor entity for the program domain and the SSOT for all program-level identity, metadata, design narrative (situation analysis, intervention logic, targeting strategy, sustainability plan), and strategic framework alignment. products.name: gift
products.description: Authoritative transactional ledger and single source of truth for every financial transaction in the donor domain — gifts, donations, matching gifts, tribute gifts, refunds, adjustments, and acknowledgements — processed through Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud and Raisers Edge NXT. This is the ONE table that answers 'what is this donor's total giving?' Captures gift date, amount, currency, gift type discriminator (cash, check, wire, in-kind, stock, crypto, matching, tribute, refund/adjustment, recurring), fund designation, campaign and appeal attribution, gift source (online, direct mail, event, major gift officer), payment method, batch reference, anonymous flag, restricted vs. unrestricted designation, and GL posting reference. For matching gifts: match ratio, matching employer/corporation, match request date, match approval status, match payment received date, maximum match amount. For tribute gifts: tribute type (in-memoriam, in-honor-of), honoree name, honoree relationship, notification recipient, notification sent flag. For refunds/adjustments: original gift reference, refund date, refund amount, refund reason, refund method, GL reversal reference. For acknowledgements: acknowledgement type, acknowledgement date, receipt number, delivery method, acknowledgement status, IRS-compliant language flag, goods-or-services disclosure. Core financial transaction for donor revenue recognition per FASB ASC 958 and IRS 501(c)(3) substantiation requirements.
products.reference: Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud Gift; Raisers Edge NXT Gift; FASB ASC 958 Contribution Revenue

products.name: pledge
products.description: Tracks multi-installment giving commitments, pledge agreements, and their individual installment schedules from donors, managed in Raisers Edge NXT and Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud. Captures pledge date, total pledge amount, installment schedule (monthly, quarterly, annual), number of installments, pledge balance outstanding, pledge status (active, fulfilled, lapsed, written-off), fund designation, campaign, appeal, reminder schedule, and write-off reason. Includes installment-level detail: individual due dates, scheduled amounts, actual payment dates, amounts paid, installment status (scheduled, paid, overdue, skipped, waived), payment method, and linked gift reference upon payment. Enables granular pledge fulfillment tracking, overdue installment identification, automated reminder generation, and BvA (Budget vs. Actual) reconciliation for pledged revenue. Distinct from gift — a pledge is a commitment to give, not a completed transaction.

products.name: event_registration
products.description: This association product represents the registration and attendance relationship between constituents and fundraising events. It captures the complete lifecycle of constituent participation in donor cultivation and fundraising activities, from initial registration through post-event follow-up. Each record links one constituent to one fundraising event with transactional attributes including registration details, ticketing information, seating assignments, payment tracking, attendance confirmation, and stewardship workflow status. This is a core operational entity managed actively by development and events staff for capacity planning, revenue tracking, donor engagement measurement, and post-event cultivation workflows.. Existence Justification: In nonprofit fundraising operations, constituents register for and attend multiple fundraising events over their donor lifecycle (galas, golf tournaments, cultivation dinners), and each event hosts multiple constituent attendees. Event registration is an actively managed operational process with its own lifecycle: registration → payment → seating assignment → check-in → post-event follow-up. This is distinct from gift processing—not all attendees make gifts, and registration data (ticket type, table assignment, dietary restrictions, attendance confirmation) is managed separately from donation transactions.

products.name: assessment
products.description: Master record of a structured field assessment conducted to evaluate needs, context, or program outcomes. Covers all assessment types including FGD (Focus Group Discussion), KII (Key Informant Interview), household survey, rapid needs assessment, PDM (Post-Distribution Monitoring) with linked distribution event and utilization/adequacy scoring, market assessment, and MUAC screening. Captures assessment date, project site, methodology, target population, sample size, assessment team, KoboToolbox or CommCare form ID, data collection tool, key findings summary, recommendations, and assessment status (planned, in-progress, completed, validated). For PDM assessments: captures linked distribution event, sample methodology, utilization rate, adequacy score, beneficiary satisfaction, complaints received, and protection concerns noted. Links to assessment_response for individual submissions. Supports MEL indicator tracking, SitRep generation, CHS compliance, accountability to affected populations (AAP), and donor reporting on program quality.

products.name: mel_logframe
products.description: Logical Framework (LogFrame) master records defining the results chain hierarchy for each program or grant. Each logframe captures the full intervention logic: goal (impact), purpose (outcome), outputs, activities, assumptions, risks, and objectively verifiable indicators (OVIs) at each level. Includes Theory of Change (ToC) components as embedded rows within the hierarchy. Aligns with DAC evaluation criteria, RBM standards, and donor-specific logframe templates (DFID/FCDO, USAID, EU, ECHO). Links to indicator targets for performance tracking and supports results framework reporting.
